swo.label: Skill 1: Subject & Verb
swo.desc: Menerangkan variasi Subject, Verb, beserta kesesuaian keduanya.

swo.label: Skill 2: Preposition
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Preposisi sebagai modifier, adverb, atau Appositive, serta posisinya dalam kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 3 : Appositive
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Appositive sebagai informasi tambahan dari Noun atau Pronoun beserta posisi dan variasinya.

swo.label: Skill 4 & 5 : Participle
swo.desc: Bentuk Participle, fungsinya, serta perbedaan dengan Gerund

swo.label: Skill 6 : Coordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan bentuk kata yang menghubungkan element yang setara (FANBOYS), parallel structure, dan Subject proximity.

swo.label: Skill 7 : Subordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan kata hubung antar clause (Main Clause & Subclause), tipe-tipe konjungsi, posisi, dan peringkasannya.

swo.label: Skill 8 : Correlative Conjunction
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk konjungsi yang selalu berpasangan, Subject Proximity, dan aturan Inversi.

swo.label: Skill 9 : Noun Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk Clause yang berfungsi seperti noun, variasi, dan reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 10 : Adjective Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan Clause yang berfungsi untuk menerangkan Noun atau Pronoun, Variasi, dan pola reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 11 : AC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-elemen tertentu pada Adjective Clause (AC), konsekuensi penghapusan, dan strukturnya.

swo.label: Skill 12 : AVC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-element tertentu yang terjadi dalam Adverbial Clause (AVC),  konsekuensi, beserta hasil akhirnya.

swo.label: Skill 13 :  Inversion in Question
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerja Bantu pada struktur tertentu.

swo.label: Skill 14 : Inversion of Place Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi tertentu yang menunjukkan Tempat dan Arah.

swo.label: Skill 15 : Inversion of Negative Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi Negative tertentu pada sebuah klausa atau kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 16 : Inversion in Conditional Sentence
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk inversi yang terjadi pada Conditional Sentence (Type 1, 2, 3).

swo.label: Skill 17 : Inversion in Comparison
swo.desc: Inversi yang terjadi pada Subject dan Auxiliary-nya dalam Comparison.

listening-skill1.audioScript: Woman: Have you finished the report for Professor Allen? Man: Almost. I still need to check the figures in the final section. Woman: The professor said he would like to receive it before noon tomorrow. Man: That should be fine. I will review it tonight and send it first thing in the morning. Woman: Great. Let me know if you need me to check anything.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: A report that needs to be completed
questions.e: They discuss checking the figures and submitting the report before the deadline.

questions.q: What does the man still need to do?
questions.e: He says he still needs to check the figures in the final section.

questions.q: When does the professor want to receive the report?
questions.e: The woman says the professor wants it before noon tomorrow.

questions.q: The committee _____ the final decision yesterday.
questions.e: The time expression 'yesterday' requires the simple past: made.

questions.q: The new library, _____ last year, is already popular with students.
questions.e: The past participle 'completed' works as a reduced passive adjective clause.

questions.q: Neither the students nor the teacher _____ aware of the schedule change.
questions.e: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Teacher' is singular, so use was.

questions.q: The researcher collected the data carefully, _____ the results were reliable.
questions.e: 'So' introduces the result: careful collection led to reliable results.

reading-skill1.passage: Urban trees provide benefits that extend beyond their appearance. Their leaves can provide shade, reducing the amount of heat absorbed by streets and buildings. Trees also help manage rainwater: some water is intercepted by leaves, while roots can improve the soil's ability to absorb rainfall. In addition, urban vegetation creates habitats for birds and insects. However, planting trees in cities requires careful planning. Species must be selected according to local climate, available space, and maintenance needs. A tree that grows well in a park may not be suitable for a narrow sidewalk where roots could damage pavement or underground pipes. Therefore, successful urban forestry depends not simply on planting more trees, but on choosing appropriate species and caring for them over time.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Why cities should remove old trees
The benefits of urban trees and the need for careful planning
Why all tree species grow well on sidewalks
questions.e: The passage describes several benefits and explains why tree selection and maintenance matter.

questions.q: According to the passage, how can trees help manage rainwater?
o: By intercepting water and improving soil absorption
questions.e: The passage states that leaves intercept some water and roots can improve soil absorption.

questions.q: The word 'intercepted' is closest in meaning to _____.
questions.e: In context, leaves catch or hold some of the rainwater.

questions.q: Why might a tree be unsuitable for a narrow sidewalk?
o: It may attract too many birds
Its roots may damage pavement or pipes
questions.e: The passage specifically mentions possible damage from roots.

questions.q: She _____ to school every day.
questions.e: With a third-person singular subject in the simple present, add -s: goes.

questions.q: There are _____ books on the table.
questions.e: 'Books' is countable, so use 'many'.

questions.q: My brother is taller _____ me.
questions.e: Comparatives use 'than'.

questions.q: The report _____ by the committee before the deadline.
questions.e: The report receives the action, so use the passive: was submitted.

questions.q: Not only _____ the exam, but she also received a scholarship.
questions.e: After 'Not only' at the start of a clause, the auxiliary comes before the subject.

questions.q: The professor, along with his students, _____ attending the conference.
questions.e: The subject is 'professor' (singular); 'along with ...' does not change the verb.

questions.q: Had the committee reviewed the proposal earlier, the errors _____ avoided.
questions.e: A third conditional (inverted) needs 'would have + past participle' in the result clause.

questions.q: The more carefully you read, _____ you will understand.
questions.e: The double comparative structure is 'the more..., the better...'.

questions.q: Rarely _____ such a remarkable performance.
questions.e: A negative adverb at the start of a sentence triggers subject–auxiliary inversion.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Coordinating Conjunction : Penghubung antar Element yang etara (Parallel Structure).

Dikenal dengan singkatan FANBOYS (For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So). Unsur yang dihubungkan wajib memiliki kedudukan dan bentuk gramatikal yang setara, serta aturan tanda baca koma yang ketat saat menghubungkan klausa.

01

Kaidah FANBOYS

For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

02

Aturan Koma

Wajib koma antar klausa, opsi koma untuk list.

03

Parallelism 

Variasi noun, adj, gerund, inf, dan clause.

04

Inversi & S-V Agreement

Aturan nor inversion & kesesuaian verb.

⚠️ Kesalahan Terbesar Peserta TOEFL (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Parallelism Mismatch Trap

Menghubungkan dua unsur berbeda jenis (misalnya Gerund dengan To-Infinitive).

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: He wants to listen or singing on the stage.

✓ Benar: He wants to listen or to sing on the stage.

Unsur sebelum dan sesudah konjungsi harus setara secara gramatikal (sama-sama to-infinitive atau gerund).

Pitfall #2 Nor Inversion Failure

Gagal melakukan inversi (pembalikan posisi auxiliary dan subjek) setelah konjungsi Nor.

Contoh Jebakan:

❌ Salah: Motorola is not familiar anymore, nor Siemens is.

✓ Benar: Motorola is not familiar anymore, nor is Siemens.

Setelah nor, struktur kalimat wajib mengalami inversi (auxiliary is mendahului subjek Siemens).
sections.content-blueprint:
Blueprint & Klasifikasi FANBOYS

Aturan Penghubung Coordinating Conjunction

FANBOYS memiliki aturan spesifik terkait level gramatikal yang dihubungkan (Word, Phrase, Gerund, To-Infinitive, maupun Clause) beserta penanda strukturalnya.

Klasifikasi Fungsi & Contoh Analisis TOEFL:

1

And, But, Or

Word, Phrase, Gerund, To-Inf, & Clause

Dapat menghubungkan kata tunggal, frasa benda, gerund, to-infinitive, maupun klausa utuh dengan struktur paralel:

Contoh Word (Kata):

The committee evaluated syntactic [and] semantic patterns in the corpus.

Contoh Clause (Klausa Lengkap S + V):

The historical archives were preserved digitally, [but] the original paper documents deteriorated.

2

For, Nor, Yet, So

Strict Clause Connectors

Wajib menghubungkan antar klausa utuh (memiliki Subjek dan Verb di kedua sisinya) dan diawali koma:

Contoh Soal TOEFL (For / So / Yet):

The TOEFL examinee studied rigorously for months, [so] she successfully achieved a score above 600.

📌 Aturan Tanda Baca Koma (Punctuation Rule):
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan 2 unsur setara (misal: 2 subjek, 2 gerund, atau 2 to-infinitive), tidak perlu koma. Contoh: My father and I go.
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan lebih dari 2 unsur (list/rincian), gunakan koma pemisah. Contoh: My father, Luna, and I go.
  • Jika FANBOYS menghubungkan 2 klausa utuh (S + V), wajib diberi koma sebelum konjungsi. Contoh: I am writing the letter, and you will send it.
sections.content-parallel:
Parallel Structure Lab

Variasi Elemen Paralel & Analisis Warna

Lab ini membedah berbagai variasi elemen gramatikal (Noun, Adjective, Gerund, To-Infinitive, hingga Auxiliary Verb) yang dihubungkan oleh Coordinating Conjunction dengan pembedaan warna khusus: Elemen 1 & 2 (Indigo), Conjunction (Emerald), serta Verb / Penanda (Amber).

1. Noun Phrase Parallelism Object Position
"The researcher collected phonological data and syntactic records."
Elemen Pertama:

phonological data (Noun Phrase sebagai Objek).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

and (Coordinating Conjunction tanpa koma karena hanya 2 unsur).

Elemen Kedua:

syntactic records (Noun Phrase setara sebagai Objek).

2. Adjective Parallelism Complement Position
"The linguistic theory was innovative, yet complex."
Elemen Pertama:

innovative (Adjective sebagai Subject Complement).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

yet (Menghubungkan dua adjektiva berlawanan makna dengan koma).

Elemen Kedua:

complex (Adjective setara sebagai Subject Complement).

3. Gerund Phrase Parallelism Subject / Object Position
"Prof. Muhandis enjoys analyzing manuscripts or teaching semantics."
Elemen Pertama:

analyzing manuscripts (Gerund Phrase).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

or (Coordinating Conjunction).

Elemen Kedua:

teaching semantics (Gerund Phrase setara).

4. To-Infinitive Parallelism Infinitive Phrase
"The institute aims to preserve local dialects and (to) publish dictionaries."
Elemen Pertama:

to preserve local dialects (To-Infinitive).

Konjungsi Penghubung:

and (Partikel 'to' pada elemen kedua boleh dihilangkan).

Elemen Kedua:

(to) publish dictionaries (To-Infinitive setara).

5. Shared Auxiliary Verb Parallelism Verb Phrase
"He is waving his arms and (is) shouting at us."
Verb Pertama:

is waving (Auxiliary is + Present Participle).

Konjungsi & Penghilangan:

and. Auxiliary (is) pada verb kedua boleh ditiadakan.

Verb Kedua:

(is) shouting (Setara bentuk V-ing).
sections.content-inversion:
Advanced Rules

Nor Inversion & Subject-Verb Agreement (Proximity Rule)

Memahami aturan inversi khusus setelah konjungsi Nor serta aturan kesesuaian verb dengan subjek terdekat (misalnya pada struktur either... or / neither... nor / or).

Aturan Inversi Nor

Nor + Auxiliary + Subject

Setelah konjungsi nor, klausa wajib dibalik (auxiliary verb mendahului subjek).

✓ Benar (Inversi):

Motorola is not familiar, nor is Siemens.

Proximity Rule (Or / Nor)

Salma or Nadia needs...

Ketika dua subjek dihubungkan oleh or atau nor, verb disesuaikan dengan subjek yang berada paling dekat dengan verb.

✓ Contoh 1 (Singular Closer):

Salma or Nadia needs to go.

Nadia (singular) dekat dengan verb -> needs.
✓ Contoh 2 (Plural Closer):

Salma or her friends need to go.

Friends (plural) dekat dengan verb -> need.
Correlative Proximity

Neither... Nor Agreement

Berlaku hal serupa pada struktur korelatif seperti neither... nor.

✓ Contoh Sesuai:

Neither the faculty members nor the department head was present.

Karena head (singular) berada paling dekat dengan verb, maka verb yang digunakan adalah was.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Ekspresi negatif di awal kalimat  : Auxiliary pindah  depan Subject (WAJIB).

Ketika ekspresi negatif atau semi-negatif diletakkan di awal kalimat sebagai penekanan, kalimat wajib inversi dengan pola Neg + aux + S + V, mirip kalimat tanya. Berbeda dengan inversi tempat, di sini yang pindah adalah auxiliary, bukan main verb.

01

Daftar Ekspresi

Negatif, semi-negatif, no-, not-, only-.

02

Pola & Auxiliary

Aux, be, atau do-support.

03

Pola Khusus

Not only, no sooner, only + adverbial.

04

Diagnostic Quiz

20 Soal (Error Analysis & Blank).

Asal Mula: Ekspresi Negatif Dipindah ke Awal untuk Penekanan

Kalimat biasa memiliki ekspresi negatif di tengah. Ketika dipindah ke awal, auxiliary ikut berpindah ke depan subject, seperti pada kalimat tanya.

Contoh Verb biasa: do-support
Kalimat biasa
Dr. Mila seldom cancels the syntax lecture without notice.
Inversi negatif (Neg + aux + S + V)
Seldom does Dr. Mila cancel the syntax lecture without notice.
Tanpa inversi (salah)
❌ Seldom Dr. Mila cancels the syntax lecture without notice.
  • Verb biasa tidak punya auxiliary, sehingga ditambahkan does (do-support).
  • Does membawa agreement dan tense, sehingga verb utama kembali ke V1 (cancel).
  • Pola ini sama dengan kalimat tanya (Skill 13), bedanya kalimatnya tetap pernyataan.

Langkah Cepat: Perlu Inversi atau Tidak?

1. Ekspresi negatif / semi-negatif berada di awal sebagai penekanan? Jika tidak → tanpa inversi.

2. Ekspresi itu adverbial (menerangkan verb / klausa), bukan bagian dari subject? Jika bagian subject (No student ...) → tanpa inversi.

3. Sudah ada aux / modal → pindahkan aux pertama. Be sebagai main verb → pindahkan be.

4. Verb biasa tanpa aux → tambah do / does / did, verb kembali V1.

5. Susun: Neg + aux + S + V.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Tidak Ada Inversi

Ekspresi negatif di awal tetapi urutan tetap deklaratif.

❌ Never I have reminded you so many times.

✓ Never have I reminded you so many times.

Pitfall #2 Verb Tidak Kembali ke V1

Setelah do / does / did, verb utama wajib V1.

❌ Seldom does Dr. Mila cancels the lecture.

✓ Seldom does Dr. Mila cancel the lecture.

Pitfall #3 Inversi di Klausa yang Salah

Pada pola "only + adverbial", inversi terjadi di main clause, bukan di klausa setelah only.

❌ Only when did he arrive, she noticed the error.

✓ Only when he arrived did she notice the error.

Pitfall #4 Negatif sebagai Bagian Subject

Jika kata negatif menerangkan subject, tidak ada inversi.

❌ Has no student passed the test.

✓ No student has passed the test.

✓ I have never reminded you. (tidak di awal, tanpa inversi)
sections.content-list:
Negative Expressions

Daftar Ekspresi Pemicu Inversi

Ketika ekspresi bermakna negatif atau semi-negatif ada di awal kalimat sebagai penekanan, kalimat wajib inversi.

Perbedaan dengan Inversi Tempat (Skill 14)
JenisYang pindahContoh
Inversi tempatMain verb (tanpa aux)On the desk sat a textbook.
Inversi negatifAuxiliary (seperti Interrogative)Seldom does Dr. Mila cancel the lecture.
1. Negative Adverbs never, nowhere
Never have I reminded you so many times about the presentation. (asal: I have never reminded you ...)
Nowhere have I seen such a beautiful library.
2. Semi-Negative rarely, seldom (jarang) | hardly, scarcely, barely (hampir tidak) | little (hampir tidak / sedikit sekali)
Seldom does Dr. Mila cancel the syntax lecture without notice. (asal: Dr. Mila seldom cancels ...)
Rarely do students finish the test early.
Little did he know about the plan.

Kata-kata ini sudah bermakna negatif, jadi jangan ditambah not atau never lagi (hindari negatif ganda).

3. No-Expressions at no time, on no account, under no circumstances, in no way, by no means, no sooner ... than
Under no circumstances should the students cheat during the TOEFL test. (asal: The students should under no circumstances cheat ...)
At no time did the committee reveal the results.
4. Not-Expressions not only ... but also, not until
Not only is Usamah traveling abroad, but he is also studying language acquisition.
Not until the results were announced did the students relax.
5. Only-Expressions (Restrictive) only once, only then, only by + Ving, only after, only when
Only once did I see the rector in the PIBI room.
Only by studying every day can you pass the TOEFL.

Kata only sendiri bersifat membatasi (restrictive), bukan "no-expression". Inversi berlaku bila only + adverbial berada di awal kalimat.
sections.content-pattern:
Core Pattern

Pola: Negative Expression + Aux + S + V

Cara menentukan auxiliary sama seperti membentuk kalimat tanya.

a. Sudah Ada Aux / Modal pindahkan aux pertama
I have never reminded you so many times. → Never have I reminded you so many times.
The students should under no circumstances cheat. → Under no circumstances should the students cheat.
He has never been so tired. → Never has he been so tired. (hanya aux pertama yang pindah)
b. Be sebagai Main Verb be itu sendiri yang pindah
Dr. Mila is seldom late. → Seldom is Dr. Mila late.
❌ Seldom does Dr. Mila be late.
c. Verb Biasa tanpa Aux do-support, verb kembali V1
Dr. Mila seldom cancels the lecture. → Seldom does Dr. Mila cancel the lecture.
She rarely visited the library. → Rarely did she visit the library.
Kapan Tidak Inversi

Inversi hanya berlaku bila ekspresi negatif adalah adverbial yang berdiri di awal kalimat untuk penekanan. Jika negatif itu bagian dari subject atau berada di posisi normal, urutan tetap deklaratif.

KondisiContoh benar
Negatif tidak di awalI have never reminded you.
Negatif bagian dari subjectNo student has passed the test.
Hardly anyone knew the answer.
Negatif adverbial di awalNever have I reminded you.
Hardly had she entered when the phone rang.

Ringkasan Pola

Ada aux / modal : Neg + aux pertama + S + sisa verb

Be main verb   : Neg + be + S + complement

Verb biasa      : Neg + do / does / did + S + V1
sections.content-special:
Special Patterns

Pola Khusus yang Sering Keluar

Pada pola dua klausa, perhatikan klausa mana yang diinversi.

1. Not only ... but also inversi hanya pada klausa pertama
Asal
Usamah is not only traveling abroad but also studying language acquisition.
Not only is Usamah traveling abroad, but he is also studying language acquisition.
klausa kedua tetap normal (S + V)
Not only does Usamah travel abroad, but he also studies language acquisition.
2. No sooner ... than & Hardly / Scarcely ... when klausa pertama: had + S + V3
No sooner had the lecture started than the power went out.
Hardly had she entered the room when the phone rang.

Klausa pertama memakai past perfect yang diinversi, klausa kedua memakai simple past biasa. No sooner berpasangan dengan than, sedangkan hardly / scarcely dengan when.

3. Only + Adverbial & Not until inversi di main clause
Only by studying every day can you pass the TOEFL.
Only when he arrived did she notice the error.
inversi di main clause (did she notice), klausa 'when he arrived' tetap normal
Not until the results were announced did the students relax.
❌ Only when did he arrive she noticed the error.
❌ Not until the results were announced the students relaxed.

Ringkasan Pola

Not only S1 ... but also S2    : inversi di klausa 1

No sooner had S V3 than ...  : inversi di klausa 1

Hardly had S V3 when ...    : inversi di klausa 1

Only / Not until + adverbial  : inversi di main clause

Kesimpulan
  • Inversi tempat: memindahkan main verb (is, sat, stood, lies) ke depan subject, dan rusak bila subject berupa pronoun.
  • Inversi negatif: memindahkan auxiliary (atau be) ke depan subject seperti kalimat tanya. Wajib bila ekspresi negatif (never, seldom, rarely, not only, dll.) berdiri di awal kalimat sebagai penekanan.

sections.content-overview:
Fundamental Grammar Axiom

Setiap kalimat dalam b. Inggris WAJIB memiliki Subject & Verb.

Dalam tes TOEFL Structure, pertanyaan sering disamarkan dengan memperpanjang modifier pada subject atau memanipulasi participle dan clause untuk mengecoh peserta.

01

Identifikasi Subject Utama

Menemukan Head Noun di tengah tumpukan modifier.

02

Subject-Verb Agreement

Menyelaraskan subjek dengan finite verb utama.

03

Phrase vs Clause

Membedakan kelompok kata tanpa predikat vs klausa.

04

Finite vs Infinite Verb

Membedakan verb utama vs verb bayangan/modifier.

⚠️ Kesalahan Terbesar Peserta TOEFL (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Salah Menentukan Subject Utama

Mengira Noun Panjang / Prepositional Object sebagai Subject Berbeda.

❌ Salah: The key to the doors are missing.

✓ Benar: The key [to the doors] is missing.

Pitfall #2 Terkecoh Verb Tambahan

Mengira V-ing / V3 Berdiri Sendiri sebagai Verb Utama Kalimat.

❌ Salah: The man standing there is my uncle.

✓ Benar: The man [standing there] is my uncle.

Pitfall #3 Kebingungan Gerund & Infinitive

Bingung Membedakan Gerund/Infinitive sebagai Subjek vs Verb.

📌 Struktur: Reading books improves knowledge.

Pitfall #4 Terkecoh Noun Clause

Mengira Noun Clause Memiliki Dua Subjek yang Terpisah.

📌 Struktur: [What he said] shocked everyone.
sections.content-subjects:
Definisi Utama

Apa itu Subject?

Bagian kalimat yang melakukan tindakan, mengalami keadaan, atau menjadi topik utama dalam sebuah klausa.

5 Elemen yang Menjadi Subject dalam Kalimat:

1

Noun / Noun Phrase 

Standar / Most Common
• Pekalongan is a city.
• Love builds a bridge.
• [The message sent by Almas] was deleted 5 minutes ago.
• [A number of students in the class] join an extra class for TOEFL.
2

Pronoun (Kata Ganti)

She, He, It, They, We, You, I
• She is intelligent.
• They arrived late.
• It seems difficult.
3

Gerund / Gerund Phrase (V-ing sebagai Noun)

Verb-ing as Singular Noun
• Reading improves vocabulary.
• Analyzing adjective clause part is hard.
• Listening, Analyzing structure, and Reading are TOEFL sections. (Compound = Plural)
4

To-Infinitive / To-Infinitive Phrase

To + V1 as Singular Subject
• To Analyze adjective clause part is hard.
• To travel around the world is my biggest dream.
5

Noun Clause (Klausa Kata Benda)

Conj + S + V / Conj + V

Diawali kata hubung: what, that, whether, why, how, who.

• [What he said] shocked everyone.
• [Whether they agree] is uncertain.
sections.content-long-subject:
Visual Breakdown

Example of Long Subject Breakdown

Soal TOEFL sering menyamarkan subjek utama dengan modifier panjang. Bedah struktur untuk menemukan Head Noun sejati.

Case #1: Prepositional Modifier The development of modern communication technologies has changed education.
Subject Lengkap The development of modern communication technologies
Head Noun (Inti) development
Post Modifier of modern communication technologies
Verb Utama has changed
Object education
Case #2: Adjective Clause Modifier The students who study linguistics often perform well.
Subject Lengkap The students who study linguistics
Head Noun students
Post Modifier who study linguistics
Verb Phrase often perform
Adverb well
Case #3: Gerund Phrase Subject Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age improves cognitive flexibility.
Subject Lengkap (Gerund Phrase) Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age
Verb Utama improves
Object cognitive flexibility
Case #4: Noun Clause Subject [What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition] remains controversial.
Subject Lengkap (Noun Clause) What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition
Main Finite Verb remains
Complement controversial
Case #5: To Infinitive Subject To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs are the main goals of the new environmental policy..
Subject Lengkap (To Infinitive) To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs
Main Finite Verb are
Complement the main goals of the new environmental policy
sections.content-verbs:
Arsitektur Verb

Klasifikasi Verb dalam TOEFL Structure

Memahami kedudukan kata kerja dan fungsinya (Finite vs Infinite) adalah kunci utama menjawab soal TOEFL.

1. Berdasarkan Kedudukan (Ordinary vs Auxiliary)

Ordinary Verb

Kata Kerja Utama

Memberikan makna substantif dalam klausa. Pasti ada dalam setiap klausa utuh.

Auxiliary Verb

Kata Kerja Bantu

Membantu ordinary verb membentuk tenses, aspek, modalitas, atau penekanan.

Variasi Auxiliary Verb:

a. Primary Aux

be, do, have

b. Modal Aux

can, could, shall, should, may, must

Harus V1 bare setelah modal

c. Emphasize Aux

do / does / did (benar-benar)

2. Berdasarkan Fungsi (Finite vs Infinite Verb Matrix)

Bentuk Verb Status Finite Syarat & Penjelasan Aturan
V1 (Bare) FINITE Berdiri sendiri (Present) atau setelah Modal.
Vs / es, V2 ALWAYS FINITE Selalu berfungsi sebagai Kata Kerja Utama Kalimat.
V-ing CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be (be + V-ing).
V3 (Past Participle) CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be atau have.
To + Infinitive ALWAYS INFINITE Tidak pernah bisa menjadi Verb Utama Kalimat.
sections.content-decomposition:
Laboratorium Analisis

Sentence Decomposition

Pelajari bagaimana kata kerja tampak (V-ing / V3) terbentuk akibat proses pemangkasan (reducing) klausa penjelas.

Case 1: Reduced Adjective Clause (V-ing) Active Reduction
"The students studying in the library are preparing for the TOEFL test."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• studying = Infinite Verb

• are preparing = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The students [who are] studying..."

Case 2: Reduced Adverbial Clause (Having + V3) Perfective Participle
"Having completed the research, the professor submitted the article."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• Having completed = Infinite Verb Phrase

• submitted = Finite Verb Utama (V2)

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "[After the professor had] completed..."

Case 3: Reduced Passive Adjective Clause (V3) Passive Reduction
"The book written by the famous linguist has become popular."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• written = Infinite Verb

• has become = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The book [which was] written..."

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Inversion in Question = Auxiliary (atau Be) Pindah ke Depan Subject. Jadi Sub Clause? Inversi Hilang.

Pertanyaan mandiri memakai susunan aux + S + V. Begitu pertanyaan itu menjadi bagian dari kalimat lain (noun clause), susunannya kembali ke S + V seperti kalimat deklaratif.

01

Inversi Aux / Be

Aux atau be pindah ke depan subject.

02

Yes/No & Information

Tanpa WH-word vs dengan WH-word.

03

Primary & Modal Aux

Be, have, do, dan modal + V1.

04

Diagnostic Quiz

20 Soal (Error Analysis & Blank).

Asal Mula: Dari Kalimat Deklaratif ke Pertanyaan, lalu ke Sub Clause

Satu kalimat yang sama bisa berubah bentuk tiga kali. Perhatikan posisi auxiliary dan subject-nya.

Contoh Verbal: butuh auxiliary
Declarative
Ainun studies Arabic syntax.
S + V + O (tidak ada aux)
Interrogative (inversi)
Does Ainun study Arabic syntax?
aux + S + V + O. Aux do-support ditambahkan, verb kembali V1.
Menjadi sub clause (noun clause)
Usamah asks if Ainun studies Arabic syntax.
Inversi hilang: kembali S + V, ditambah conjunction.
  • Verb biasa tidak bisa berpindah, jadi kalimat tanya memakai aux do / does / did.
  • Aux membawa tense dan agreement, sehingga verb utama kembali ke bentuk dasar (V1).
  • Pada sub clause tidak ada aux di depan subject, sehingga verb berkonjugasi lagi (studies).

Langkah Cepat Membentuk Pertanyaan

1. Verb utama = be → pindahkan be: Prof. Uceng is famous → Is Prof. Uceng famous?

2. Sudah ada aux / modal → pindahkan aux pertama: Has he been studying?

3. Verb biasa tanpa aux → tambah do / does / did, verb kembali V1.

4. Information question: WH-word + aux + S + V. Pengecualian: WH-word sebagai subject tidak memakai inversi.

5. Menjadi sub clause → tanpa inversi: if / whether / WH-word + S + V.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Tidak Ada Inversi

Pertanyaan mandiri tetap memakai susunan deklaratif.

❌ When you will go for KKL in Bali?

✓ When will you go for KKL in Bali?

Aux harus mendahului subject.

Pitfall #2 Verb Tidak Kembali ke V1

Setelah do / does / did dan modal, verb utama wajib V1.

❌ Does Ainun studies Arabic syntax?

✓ Does Ainun study Arabic syntax?

❌ Can you speaks English?

✓ Can you speak English?

Pitfall #3 Inversi Terbawa ke Sub Clause

Di dalam noun clause, susunan harus deklaratif.

❌ Mursal is curious when will he go for KKL.

✓ Mursal is curious when he will go for KKL.

❌ Usamah asks if does Ainun study syntax.

✓ Usamah asks if Ainun studies syntax.

Pitfall #4 Aux Dipaksakan pada WH-Subject

Jika WH-word sendiri adalah subject, tidak ada inversi dan tidak ada do-support.

❌ Who did call you last night?

✓ Who called you last night?
sections.content-concept:
Fundamental Concept

Konsep Inversi dan Jenis Kalimat Tanya

Inversi adalah perubahan urutan subject dan verb. Auxiliary dipindahkan ke depan subject untuk membentuk kalimat tanya.

Dua Pola Inversi
Jenis kalimatDeclarativeInterrogative
Verbal
butuh auxiliary		Ainun studies Arabic syntax.
S + V + O		Does Ainun study Arabic syntax?
aux + S + V + O
Be sebagai main verb (nominal)
tanpa aux tambahan		Prof. Uceng is very famous.
S + V + Comp		Is Prof. Uceng very famous?
V + S + Comp

Pada verbal, aux wajib hadir saat inversi. Pada kalimat dengan be sebagai main verb, be itu sendiri yang berpindah sehingga tidak perlu aux lain.

1. Yes/No Question aux + S + V (tanpa WH-word)

Jawabannya ya atau tidak. Tidak memakai kata tanya.

Nominal (be)
Are you ready?
Modal
Can you speak English?
Have (perfect)
Have you finished the test?
2. Information Question WH-word + aux + S + V

Memakai kata tanya: what, where, when, why, how, who, whom, whose, which, dan variasinya (how many, how much, how long).

When + modal
When will you go for KKL in Bali?
How many + have
How many times have I reminded you?
Nominal (be)
Whose number is it?

Pengecualian: WH-word sebagai subject. Jika kata tanya sendiri adalah subject, susunannya tetap seperti deklaratif, tanpa inversi dan tanpa do-support.

✓ Who called you last night?  (bukan: Who did call ...)
✓ What happened in the lab?  (bukan: What did happen ...)

Ringkasan Pola

Yes/No         : aux + S + V   (be: be + S + Comp)

Information    : WH + aux + S + V

WH = subject : WH + V  (tanpa inversi)
sections.content-aux:
Auxiliary Verbs

Jenis Auxiliary dalam Inversi

Auxiliary adalah kata kerja bantu yang menjadi kunci pembentukan inversi.

1. Primary Auxiliaries
AuxiliaryBentuk yang berpindahContoh
beis, am, are, was, were, beenIs Naila studying now?
Was the test finished?
havehave, has, hadHave you finished the test?
dodo, does, didDoes Ainun study syntax?

Bentuk be, been, being tidak berpindah sendirian, hanya bentuk finite (is, am, are, was, were) yang berada di depan subject.

2. Modal Auxiliaries can, could, shall, should, will, would, may, might, must

Setelah modal, verb WAJIB V1.

✓ Can you speak English?
❌ Can you speaks / spoke English?
3. Aturan Penting

a. Do-support: untuk verb biasa tanpa aux

Ainun studies syntax. → Does Ainun study syntax?
They passed the test. → Did they pass the test?

b. Hanya aux pertama yang berpindah

He has been studying English. → Has he been studying English?
She would have finished the report. → Would she have finished the report?
The report has been submitted. → Has the report been submitted?

c. Kalimat pasif memakai be (bukan do)

✓ Was the experiment conducted by the researchers?
❌ Did the experiment conducted by the researchers?

Ringkasan Pola

Modal + S + V1

Do / does / did + S + V1

Have / has / had + S + V3  |  Be + S + Ving / V3

Banyak aux → aux pertama pindah, sisanya tetap di belakang subject
sections.content-sub:
Restriction

Pertanyaan sebagai Sub Clause (Noun Clause)

Bentuk interrogative bisa menjadi sub clause. Jika itu terjadi, inversi tidak berlaku, baik untuk yes/no maupun information question.

Cara Mengubah Pertanyaan → Declarative + Conjunction
JenisPertanyaan mandiriSub clause
Yes/NoDoes Ainun study Arabic syntax?Usamah asks if Ainun studies Arabic syntax.
InformationWhen will he go for KKL in Bali?Mursal is curious when he will go for KKL in Bali.
NominalWhose number is it?Everyone in PIBI class knows whose number it is.
Yang Berubah Saat Menjadi Sub Clause
  • Aux di depan subject dikembalikan ke susunan S + V (inversi hilang).
  • Do-support (do / does / did) dibuang, verb utama berkonjugasi lagi (study → studies).
  • Yes/No question memerlukan if / whether. Information question memakai WH-word sebagai penghubung.
  • Sub clause ini disebut noun clause karena berposisi seperti noun (object, complement, dan sebagainya).
❌ Usamah asks if does Ainun study Arabic syntax.
✓ Usamah asks if Ainun studies Arabic syntax.
Dua Kasus yang Sering Menjebak

1. Main clause sendiri berupa pertanyaan

Inversi hanya pada main clause, noun clause tetap deklaratif.

✓ Do you know where he lives?
❌ Do you know where does he live?

2. WH-word adalah subject di dalam noun clause

Susunannya tidak berubah karena memang tidak ada inversi sejak awal.

✓ Who called you? → I know who called you.

Ringkasan Aturan

1. Pertanyaan mandiri → aux + S + V.

2. Pertanyaan menjadi sub clause → if / whether / WH + S + V (tanpa inversi).

3. Main clause berupa pertanyaan → inversi hanya pada main clause.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Adjective Clause Reduction = Menghapus elemen tertentu agar kalimat ringkas namun makna tetap.

Yang dihapus bisa conjunction saja (who, whom, which, that) atau conjunction + subject sekaligus. Cara menentukannya: lihat apa yang diwakili conjunction di dalam klausa, object atau subject.

01

Hapus Conjunction Saja

Hanya bila conjunction = object.

02

Hapus Conj-Subject

Ving, V3, adjective, prep. phrase, to infinitive.

03

Tidak Boleh Direduksi

Non-defining clause dan whose.

04

Diagnostic Quiz

20 Soal (Error Analysis & Blank).

Asal Mula Adjective Clause: Dua Klausa Dijadikan Satu

Adjective clause lahir dari dua kalimat yang membicarakan noun yang sama. Kalimat kedua dipakai untuk menjelaskan noun tersebut. Noun yang berulang diganti conjunction (who, whom, which, that), lalu klausa itu diletakkan tepat di belakang noun yang dijelaskan.

Contoh Conjunction mewakili object
Klausa 1 (inti kalimat)
The man is Ferry Irwandi.
Klausa 2 (penjelas)
I met the man yesterday.
Digabung: adjective clause
The man whom I met yesterday is Ferry Irwandi.
Direduksi
The man whom I met yesterday is Ferry Irwandi.
The man I met yesterday is Ferry Irwandi.
  • Pada klausa 2, the man adalah object dari met (I met him).
  • The man diganti whom, lalu klausa dipindah ke belakang the man di klausa 1.
  • Setelah whom masih ada subject baru (I), jadi whom boleh dihapus saja. Makna tidak berubah.

Langkah Cepat: Lihat Apa yang Ada Tepat Setelah Conjunction

Conj + Subject + Verb → conj = object → hapus conjunction saja

Conj + Verb → conj = subject → hapus conjunction (+ be), verb berubah

The man whom I met is Ferry. → The man I met is Ferry.

The boy who speaks speaking at the front is Yusuf.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Menghapus Conjunction Subject Saja

Menghapus who/which/that yang berfungsi sebagai subject tanpa mengubah verb.

❌ The man saw me yesterday is Ferry.

✓ The man who saw me yesterday is Ferry.

Conjunction subject hanya boleh hilang bila verb berubah menjadi Ving / V3 / phrase.

Pitfall #2 Sisa Conjunction di Klausa Tereduksi

Menyisakan who/which sementara be sudah dibuang.

❌ Dollar which presented by him is oversimplified.

✓ Dollar presented by him is oversimplified.

✓ Dollar which is presented by him is oversimplified.

Pilih salah satu: reduksi penuh (tanpa conjunction) atau klausa utuh (conjunction + be).

Pitfall #3 Aktif vs Pasif Tertukar

Memakai Ving untuk makna pasif, atau V3 untuk makna aktif.

❌ The funds collecting by Ferry Irwandi ...

✓ The funds collected by Ferry Irwandi ...

❌ The teacher made us engage ...

✓ The teacher making us engage ...

Pitfall #4 Ving setelah Ordinal / Superlative / Only

Setelah the first, the smartest, the only, next, last, TOEFL memakai to infinitive.

❌ You are the only person understanding me.

✓ You are the only person to understand me.
sections.content-conj:
Reduction Type 1

Penghapusan Conjunction Saja

Conjunction who, whom, which, that boleh dihapus hanya jika mewakili object dalam klausa tersebut.

Conjunction = Object Noun + [whom / which / that + Subject + Verb] → Noun + Subject + Verb

Setelah conjunction ada subject baru. Subject itu tetap menjadi pelaku verb, sehingga conjunction cukup dihapus dan makna tidak berubah.

Orang (whom)
The man whom I met is Ferry Irwandi.
Red ➭ The man I met is Ferry Irwandi.
whom / that
Every official whom / that the activists criticize is highly defensive.
Red ➭ Every official the activists criticize is highly defensive.
Benda (which / that)
The book that I read is Madilog.
Red ➭ The book I read is Madilog.
Conjunction = Subject Noun + [who / which / that + Verb] → tidak boleh hanya dihapus

Jika conjunction langsung diikuti verb, conjunction itu adalah subject. Menghapusnya begitu saja membuat kalimat kehilangan subject. Lihat Tab 3 untuk cara mereduksinya.

❌ The man who saw me yesterday is Ferry. → The man saw me yesterday is Ferry.
✓ The man who saw me yesterday is Ferry. / The man seeing me ... (sesuai Tab 3)
sections.content-subject:
Reduction Type 2

Penghapusan Conj-Subject

Jika conjunction mewakili subject, hasil reduksi mengubah verb menjadi Participle (Ving / V3) atau menyisakan adjective / prepositional phrase / to infinitive, tergantung jenis kalimatnya.

a. Kalimat Aktif → Present Participle (Ving)

Buang conjunction, ubah verb menjadi Ving.

I like the teacher who makes making us engage in dialectics.
which/who + makes → making
The boy who speaks speaking at the front is Yusuf.
who + speaks → speaking

Untuk verb present / umum. Simple past aktif (who stole) tidak diubah menjadi Ving karena maknanya bergeser (lihat Skill 10).

b. Kalimat Pasif → Past Participle (V3)

Buang conjunction + be, sisakan V3.

The funds which were collected by Ferry Irwandi will be used to mitigate forest fires.
Dollar which is presented by him is oversimplified.
c. Menyisakan Adjective / Prepositional Phrase / To Infinitive Phrase

Menyisakan Adjective (who/which + be + adjective)

The man who is responsible for the MBG project is Sudaryono.

Menyisakan Prepositional Phrase (who/which + be + prep. phrase)

The committee that was in the contest blamed the participant's articulation.

Menjadi To Infinitive Phrase (setelah ordinal number, superlative, next, last, only)

Bentuk: to + V (aktif) atau to be + V3 (pasif). Setelah head ini, TOEFL memakai to infinitive, bukan Ving (the only person understanding).

Ordinal number (the first, second, next, last)
Bilal bin Rabah is the first man who performed to perform the adzan.
Superlative (the smartest, the best, the largest)
Nicolas Tesla is the smartest man who won to win the admiration of scientists worldwide.
The only
You are the only person who understands to understand me.
Makna pasif: to be + V3, atau ever + V3 (superlative + ever)
She was the second woman who was to be elected as rector.
It is the tallest building that has ever been ever built in the city.

Ringkasan Pola

Aktif   : conj + V → Ving

Pasif   : conj + be + V3 → V3

Be + adj / prep. phrase : conj + be dibuang → adj / prep. phrase

Ordinal / superlative / only / next / last : conj + V → to V (pasif: to be V3)

Verb utama : tetap mengikuti head noun → Every official criticized by the activists is ...
sections.content-never:
Restriction

🔑 Adjective Clause yang Tidak Boleh Direduksi

1. Non-Defining Clause (Appositive)

Jika klausa berada di antara tanda koma , ... , (informasi tambahan yang tidak esensial), koma dan konjungsinya tidak boleh dihilangkan secara sembarangan.

✓ My mother, who is cooking in the kitchen, is 50 years old.
❌ My mother, cooking in the kitchen, is 50 years old.

💡 Pola which is + noun phrase yang diubah menjadi appositive (mis. Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia, is ...) adalah bentuk lain yang dibahas di Skill 10. Pada soal, jangan menghapus conjunction non-defining tanpa alasan struktural yang jelas.

2. Conjunction Whose (Kepemilikan)

Whose tidak pernah bisa dihapus karena berfungsi menunjukkan kepemilikan.

✓ I know the man whose car was stolen. (Saya tahu pria yang mobilnya dicuri.)
❌ I know the man car was stolen.
❌ I know the man who car was stolen. (who bukan pengganti whose)

Ringkasan 3 Aturan

1. Conjunction = object → hapus conjunction saja.

2. Conjunction = subject → hapus conjunction, verb berubah (Ving / V3 / adj / prep. phrase / to V).

3. Non-defining (koma) dan whose → jangan direduksi sembarangan.
